name: skill-incubator
description: Presentation workflows for turning research material into editable PowerPoint decks and reusable presentation templates.

interface.shortDescription: Paper-to-PPT adaptation and editable presentation production
interface.longDescription: Skill Incubator contains Paper2PPT for evidence-led academic source preparation and PPT Master for creating, filling, enhancing, validating, and exporting editable PowerPoint presentations.
defaultPrompt: Use paper2ppt to turn this scientific paper into presentation-ready source material
Use ppt-master to create, fill, or enhance an editable PowerPoint presentation
